newsitem.title: USA: Magten cuts Revco stake to 8.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Magten cuts Revco stake to 8.8 pct.

text.p: Magten Asset Management Corp said Wednesday it reduced its stake in Revco D.S. Inc to 8.8 percent or 6,016,649 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Magten, a New York-based investment adviser, said it sold 741,880 common shares between August 15 andf September 18 at prices ranging from $24.75 to $25.994 a share.
Twinsburg, Onio-based Revco is the nation's second largest retail drug store chain. Its recent bid of $15 a share for Big B Inc was rejected by Big B on Septembern 23 as inadequate.
